camel_example: aliyun aidge ImageTranslationProAsync --region cn-hangzhou --SourceLanguage zh --ImageUrl 'https://example.com/image.jpg' --TargetLanguage en --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates images asynchronously by using Image Translation Pro. Designed for e-commerce images, this service integrates multimodal large language models to achieve more accurate image understanding, significantly improve translation quality, and continuously expand and optimize multilingual translation capabilities. It supports more than 400 language pairs, including bridged language pairs
description_zh: 图片翻译Pro版产品专为电商图片设计，融合多模态大模型技术，实现对图片的更精准理解，显著提高翻译质量，并不断扩展和优化多语言翻译能力。支持400多种语向(含桥接)
kebab_example: aliyun aidge image-translation-pro-async --source-language zh --target-language en --image-url https://example.com/image.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImageTranslationProAsync

parameters.help_en: The source language code. The value auto is supported for automatic detection
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码；支持 auto（自动检测）
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. For supported language pairs, see the appendix
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码；支持的语向见附录
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
• Image URL: The URL must be publicly accessible over the Internet.   
• Formats: PNG, JPEG, JPG, BMP, and WEBP.   
• Pixels: The width and height cannot exceed 4,000 pixels.  
• File size: The original file size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
• 图片 URL：需公网可访问。   
• 格式：png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp   
• 像素： 宽和高均不超过 4000  
• 文件大小：原始文件 ≤ 10 MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate the text on the image subject. Set this parameter to false to protect the subject information, such as the product name, from being translated. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片主体上文字。设为 false 可保护主体信息不被翻译（如商品名称）。默认值：false
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return layout information such as the position, font, and color of the text. If you set this parameter to true, layer information is returned, which can be used for secondary editing when you integrate an image editor. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回文字的位置、字体、颜色等布局信息。当选择true时可获取图层信息，可接入图片编辑器进行二次编辑。默认值：false
parameters.name: use_image_editor

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names in the image. Default value: false, which indicates that brand names are not translated
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片上的品牌名。默认 false（不翻译品牌名）
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. You must create the glossary in the console and provide its ID. If this parameter is left empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表 ID。需要在前台单独创建并提供其 ID。如为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the caller. This ID is recorded when the request is accepted and returned as-is when you query the asynchronous task result
parameters.help_zh: 调用方业务单号，受理时记录并在查询异步任务结果时原样返回
parameters.name: biz_id

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of success indicates that the task is submitted
Code.description_zh: 响应代码；"success" 代表任务提交成功
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The submission result of the Image Translation Pro asynchronous task
Data.description_zh: 图片翻译 Pro 异步任务提交结果

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. This ID is used to query results and associate notifications. Do not use the example prefix as a business validation rule
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务标识，用于结果查询和通知关联；不以示例前缀作为业务校验规则
TaskId.title_en: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID

Data.title_en: 图片翻译 Pro 异步任务提交结果
Data.title_zh: 图片翻译 Pro 异步任务提交结果

Message.description_en: The call description. A value of Success indicates a successful call. If the call fails, read the actual error message
Message.description_zh: 调用说明；成功示例为 Success，失败时读取实际错误信息
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the submission request. This ID is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次提交请求 ID，用于排查

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the submission call is successful. This does not indicate that the translation is complete
Success.description_zh: 提交调用是否成功，不代表翻译已完成
